evidence_boundaries: The PST article contains a direct LWFA focus scan, but its 2.2 GeV optimum is quasi-3D FBPIC whereas the experimental maximum is about 1.4 GeV; the ideal simulation also overpredicts the injection window.

The Optics Express results are author 2D EPOCH simulations and analytic scaling; there is no 3D run or experiment, and the estimated 80-500 TW short-wavelength driver remains a future facility requirement.

The perovskite paper directly measures Cs-137 energy response and D-D mixed-field pulse-shape discrimination; its 10.1% interaction probability and 3.6% mean deposited fraction are model results rather than absolute efficiency measurements.
No FBPIC, EPOCH, Monte Carlo neutron transport, PSD fitting, source conversion, dose or shielding calculation was rerun locally.
